const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', '.next', 'dist', 'build', 'out', 'storybook-static', 'public', '.git', 'coverage'])
const EXTS = new Set(['.tsx', '.jsx', '.ts', '.js', '.mdx', '.html', '.css'])
// Never scan the check itself (its fix strings look like classes).
const SELF = /(^|[\\/])quill-check(\.template)?\.mjs$/

export function listFiles(root, { dirs = [root], includeUi = false } = {}) {
  const out = []
  const walk = (dir) => {
    for (const name of readdirSync(dir).sort()) {
      const p = join(dir, name)
      if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) {
        if (SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) continue
        // Stock shadcn primitives are restyled by tokens and never edited — not the agent's code.
        if (!includeUi && name === 'ui' && /(^|[\\/])components$/.test(dir)) continue
        walk(p)
      } else if (EXTS.has(extname(name)) && !name.endsWith('.d.ts') && !SELF.test(p)) out.push(p)
    }
  }
  for (const d of dirs) if (existsSync(d)) walk(d)
  return out
}

const PREFIX_SET = new Set(DATA.prefixes)
const QUILL = new Set(DATA.quillClasses)

// The utility after its variants: the segment after the last `:` that sits outside brackets,
// so `data-[state=open]:bg-x` and `has-[[aria-invalid=true]]:border-x` split correctly.
export function baseOf(token) {
  let depth = 0
  let cut = -1
  for (let i = 0; i < token.length; i++) {
    const ch = token[i]
    if (ch === '[' || ch === '(') depth++
    else if (ch === ']' || ch === ')') depth--
    else if (ch === ':' && depth === 0) cut = i
  }
  return token.slice(cut + 1).replace(/^!/, '').replace(/^-(?=[a-z])/, '')
}

// A utility we read is `prefix-something`: a bare word (`text`, `from`) is prose, not a class.
// Bracket utilities of every prefix pass too: layout ones are counted in the summary.
// Spacing, size and border-width utilities (rule 6) pass when a value follows the dash — a
// number, a bracket, or a size word — so `p-13` is read and `top-level` or `end-to-end` is not.
// (Before 1.28.0 they were never read at all, so `w-64` or `p-13` reached no rule.)
const SIZE_NAME = (v) => v in DATA.tokens.size.width || v in DATA.tokens.size.height
const valueAfterDash = (re, base) => { const m = base.match(re); return !!m && (/^[\d[]/.test(m.at(-1)) || SIZE_WORD.test(m.at(-1)) || CONTAINER.test(m.at(-1)) || SIZE_NAME(m.at(-1))) }
const looksLikeUtility = (base) => {
  if (valueAfterDash(SPACE_RE, base) || valueAfterDash(SIZE_RE, base) || WIDTH_RE.test(base) || /^text-[6-9]xl$/.test(base)) return true
  const m = base.match(/^([a-z]+)-[a-z0-9([]/)
  return !!m && (PREFIX_SET.has(m[1]) || QUILL.has(base) || /-\[.+\]$/.test(base))

const BARE_ROUNDED = /^rounded(-[tblrse]{1,2})?$/

// Every whitespace-separated token inside a string literal that looks like a utility we read.
// Template-literal holes become spaces so `${cond ? 'a' : 'b'}` never glues onto a class.
export function extractCandidates(text) {
  const out = []
  const lineStarts = [0]
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) if (text[i] === '\n') lineStarts.push(i + 1)
  const lineOf = (idx) => {
    let lo = 0
    let hi = lineStarts.length - 1
    while (lo < hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1
      if (lineStarts[mid] <= idx) lo = mid
      else hi = mid - 1
    }
    return lo
  }
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/'([^'\n]*)'|"([^"\n]*)"|`([^`]*)`/g)) {
    const literal = (m[1] ?? m[2] ?? m[3]).replace(/\$\{[^}]*\}/g, (h) => ' '.repeat(h.length))

    const found = []

    for (const t of literal.matchAll(/\S+/g)) {
      // prose punctuation glued to a class (`font-heading,`) is not part of it
      const token = t[0].replace(/[.,;:!?'"]+$/, '')
      if (!token) continue
      const base = baseOf(token)
      const isBare = BARE_ROUNDED.test(base)
      if (!isBare && !looksLikeUtility(base)) continue
      const idx = start + t.index
      const line = lineOf(idx)
      ;(isBare ? bare : found).push({ token, base, line: line + 1, col: idx - lineStarts[line] + 1 })
    }
    out.push(...found, ...(found.length ? bare : []))
  }
  return out
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rules 2–5 (pure)
const COLOR_PREFIXES = new Set(['bg', 'text', 'border', 'ring', 'outline', 'fill', 'stroke', 'from', 'to', 'via', 'decoration', 'divide', 'placeholder', 'caret', 'accent', 'shadow'])

const STOCK_SHADE = /^([a-z]+)-(50|[1-9]00|950)$/
const family = (prefix) => (['text', 'placeholder', 'caret', 'decoration', 'fill', 'stroke'].includes(prefix) ? 'text' : ['border', 'ring', 'outline', 'divide'].includes(prefix) ? 'border' : 'bg')

// Rule 2: Tailwind's stock palette. Bare `indigo`, `teal`, `moss`… are Quill pigments and pass;
// only `white`, `black` and numbered shades are stock.
export function paletteRule(base) {

  if (!m) return null
  const [, prefix, rest] = m
  if (prefix === 'font' && rest === 'serif') return { rule: 'palette', fix: '→ font-heading (Fraunces, the display face)' }
  if (!COLOR_PREFIXES.has(prefix)) return null
  let hue = null
  if (rest === 'white' || rest === 'black') hue = rest
  else {
    const s = rest.match(STOCK_SHADE)
    if (s && HUE_GROUP[s[1]]) hue = s[1]
  }
  if (!hue) return null
  const roles = DATA.palette[family(prefix)][HUE_GROUP[hue]] ?? []
  const fix = roles.length
    ? `→ ${roles.map((r) => withIntent(prefix, r)).join(' or ')}`
    : '→ no Quill pigment sits here — pick a role by job (roles section of .claude/rules/quill.md)'
  return { rule: 'palette', fix }

const LAYOUT = new Set(['w', 'h', 'min', 'max', 'size', 'grid', 'inset', 'top', 'left', 'right', 'bottom', 'start', 'end', 'translate', 'p', 'px', 'py', 'pt', 'pr', 'pb', 'pl', 'ps', 'pe', 'm', 'mx', 'my', 'mt', 'mr', 'mb', 'ml', 'ms', 'me', 'gap', 'space', 'basis', 'col', 'row', 'aspect', 'z', 'order', 'flex', 'scroll', 'indent', 'columns', 'auto', 'content', 'origin', 'rotate', 'scale', 'skew', 'perspective', 'mask', 'clip', 'object', 'line', 'list', 'transition', 'delay', 'animate', 'will', 'backdrop', 'blur', 'brightness', 'contrast', 'opacity'])
const toPx = (v) => {
  const m = v.match(/^(-?[\d.]+)(px|rem|em)?$/)

}
const nearest = (table, n) => Object.entries(table).sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a[1] - n) - Math.abs(b[1] - n))[0]
const scale = (util, table, unit) => Object.entries(table).map(([k, v]) => `${util}-${k} ${v}${unit}`).join(' · ')
const motionFix = (kind) => kind === 'duration'
  ? `→ ${Object.entries(DATA.tokens.motion.duration).map(([v, n]) => `duration-(${v}) ${n}ms`).join(' · ')}`
  : `→ ${DATA.tokens.motion.ease.map((v) => `ease-(${v})`).join(' · ')}`

// Rule 4: a bracket value where Quill has a token. Returns a finding, 'layout' (counted), or
// null (not a bracket). Spacing, size and border-width brackets never reach it: rule 6 reads
// those first. What is left on a layout prefix (`grid-cols-[…]`, `z-[5]`) has no token.
export function bracketRule(base) {
  const m = base.match(/^([a-z]+)((?:-[a-z]+)*)-\[(.+)\]$/)
  if (!m) return null
  const [, prefix, , inner] = m
  if (LAYOUT.has(prefix) || inner.startsWith('url(')) return 'layout'

  const varRef = inner.match(/^var\((--[a-z0-9-]+)\)$/)

    if (varRef) return DATA.vars[varRef[1]] ? { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ ${prefix}-${DATA.vars[varRef[1]]}` } : 'layout'
    return colourLike ? { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ a role or pigment — nearest ${hexHint(inner, prefix)}` } : 'layout'
  }
  if (prefix === 'text') {
    if (varRef) return DATA.vars[varRef[1]] ? { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ text-${DATA.vars[varRef[1]]}` } : 'layout'
    if (colourLike) return { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ a role or pigment — nearest ${hexHint(inner, 'text')}` }
    const n = toPx(inner)
    if (n === null) return 'layout'
    const [k, v] = nearest(DATA.tokens.text, n)
    return { rule: 'bracket', fix: Math.abs(v - n) < 0.05 ? `→ text-${k}` : `→ nearest text-${k} (${v}px); the scale: ${scale('text', DATA.tokens.text, 'px')}` }
  }
  if (prefix === 'rounded') {
    const n = toPx(inner)
    if (n === null) return { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ one of ${scale('rounded', DATA.tokens.radius, 'px')}` }
    const [k, v] = nearest(DATA.tokens.radius, n)
    return { rule: 'bracket', fix: Math.abs(v - n) < 0.05 ? `→ rounded-${k}` : `→ nearest rounded-${k} (${v}px); the scale: ${scale('rounded', DATA.tokens.radius, 'px')}` }
  }
  if (prefix === 'tracking') {
    const n = parseFloat(inner)
    const [k, v] = nearest(DATA.tokens.tracking, n)
    return { rule: 'bracket', fix: Math.abs(v - n) < 0.005 ? `→ tracking-${k}` : `→ one of ${scale('tracking', DATA.tokens.tracking, 'em')}` }
  }
  if (prefix === 'leading') {
    const n = parseFloat(inner)
    const [k, v] = nearest(DATA.tokens.leading, n)
    return { rule: 'bracket', fix: Math.abs(v - n) < 0.005 ? `→ leading-${k}` : `→ one of ${scale('leading', DATA.tokens.leading, '')}` }
  }
  if (prefix === 'shadow') return { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ one of ${DATA.tokens.shadow.map((s) => `shadow-${s}`).join(' · ')}` }
  if (prefix === 'font') return { rule: 'bracket', fix: inner.includes('family') ? '→ font-heading (Fraunces) or font-sans (Raleway) — the theme loads both' : '→ font-medium / font-semibold; Quill uses 400 / 500 / 600 only' }

// Rule 6: Quill's size scales. Spacing (padding, margin, gap, offsets), border width, type and
// radius are Quill tokens, and the theme points each Tailwind utility at them — but Tailwind
// still compiles a step Quill does not have (`p-13`, `p-3.25`, `border-5`) and every bracket, and
// no theme can stop it. So: a step or bracket length outside the scale is a finding, with the
// nearest step as the fix. Widths and heights (1.29.0) take the spacing steps or the size steps
// named for their job (`w-card`, `max-w-page`, `h-frame`); a height step is a height, so on
// padding (`p-frame`) or as a width (`w-frame`) it is a finding too.
const SPACE_RE = /^(p[xytrblse]?|m[xytrblse]?|gap(?:-[xy])?|space-[xy]|inset(?:-[xy])?|top|left|right|bottom|start|end|translate-[xy]|scroll-[mp][xytrblse]?|indent)-(.+)$/
const SIZE_RE = /^(w|h|size|min-w|min-h|max-w|max-h|basis)-(.+)$/
const WIDTH_RE = /^(border(?:-[xytrblse])?|divide-[xy]|ring|ring-offset|inset-ring|outline|outline-offset)-(\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\[.+\])$/
// Values that are not a size choice: nothing, a hairline, a share of the parent, the viewport, the content.
const SIZE_WORD = /^(0|px|auto|full|screen|svh|lvh|dvh|svw|lvw|dvw|min|max|fit|none|lh|\d+\/\d+)$/
const CONTAINER = /^(3xs|2xs|xs|sm|md|lg|xl|[2-7]xl|prose)$/
// Tailwind's own width scale, in px, so `max-w-md` can be pointed at the nearest Quill size.
const TAILWIND_CONTAINER = { '3xs': 256, '2xs': 288, xs: 320, sm: 384, md: 448, lg: 512, xl: 576, '2xl': 672, '3xl': 768, '4xl': 896, '5xl': 1024, '6xl': 1152, '7xl': 1280 }
const WIDTH_PROPS = new Set(['w', 'min-w', 'max-w', 'basis'])
// The steps a width or height utility may use: the spacing steps, then the size steps of its kind.
const sizeTable = (group) => ({ ...DATA.tokens.space, ...DATA.tokens.size[group] })
const job = (group, k) => DATA.tokens.sizeJobs[group][k] ?? ''
// A bare `border`, `ring`, `outline` or `divide-x` is 1px, so the 1px step is written without a number.
const BARE_ONE = /^(border(-[xytrblse])?|divide-[xy]|ring|outline)$/
const LENGTH = /^(-?[\d.]+)(px|rem)$/

const nearestStep = (table, n) => [...stepsOf(table)].sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a[1] - n) - Math.abs(b[1] - n))[0]

const either = (prefix, table, n, sign) => {

  if (!below) return `→ ${name(above)}, Quill's smallest step`

  const [k, v] = nearestStep(table, n)

}
const TAILWIND_TEXT = { '6xl': 60, '7xl': 72, '8xl': 96, '9xl': 128 }

export function sizeRule(base, token = base) {
  const sign = /^!?-/.test(token.slice(token.lastIndexOf(':') + 1)) ? '-' : ''
  const space = DATA.tokens.space
  let m
  if ((m = base.match(SPACE_RE))) {
    const [, prefix, value] = m
    if (SIZE_WORD.test(value) || value in space) return null
    if (value in DATA.tokens.size.height) return { rule: 'scale', fix: `${either(prefix, space, DATA.tokens.size.height[value], sign).replace(", Quill's largest step", '')}: ${value} is a height (${fmt(DATA.tokens.size.height[value])}, ${job('height', value)}), not a spacing step` }
    if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(value)) return { rule: 'scale', fix: either(prefix, space, parseFloat(value) * 4, sign) }
    const inner = value.match(/^\[(.+)\]$/)?.[1]
    if (!inner) return null
    const ref = inner.match(/^var\(--space-([\d_]+)\)$/)
    if (ref) return { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ ${sign}${prefix}-${ref[1].replace('_', '.')} (the same step)` }
    const n = lengthPx(inner)
    return n === null ? 'layout' : { rule: 'bracket', fix: nearestFix(prefix, space, Math.abs(n), sign || (n < 0 ? '-' : '')) }
  }
  if ((m = base.match(SIZE_RE))) {
    const [, prefix, value] = m
    const group = WIDTH_PROPS.has(prefix) ? 'width' : 'height' // size- sets both; it rides the spacing family, like heights
    const table = sizeTable(group)
    const other = group === 'width' ? 'height' : 'width'
    if (SIZE_WORD.test(value) || value in table) return null
    if (value in DATA.tokens.size[other]) {
      const n = DATA.tokens.size[other][value]
      return { rule: 'scale', fix: `${nearestFix(prefix, table, n, sign)}: ${value} is a ${other} step (${job(other, value)})` }
    }
    if (CONTAINER.test(value)) {
      const n = TAILWIND_CONTAINER[value]
      if (!n) return { rule: 'scale', fix: `→ ${prefix}-measure (${fmt(DATA.tokens.size.width.measure)}), Quill's readable column; ${base} is Tailwind's own` }
      return { rule: 'scale', fix: `${nearestFix(prefix, table, n, sign)}; ${base} is Tailwind's own width scale (${fmt(n)})` }
    }
    if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(value)) return { rule: 'scale', fix: nearestFix(prefix, table, parseFloat(value) * 4, sign) }

    if (!inner) return null
    const ref = inner.match(/^var\(--(space|size)-([a-z0-9_-]+)\)$/)
    if (ref) return { rule: 'bracket', fix: `→ ${prefix}-${ref[2].replace('_', '.')} (the same step)` }
    const n = lengthPx(inner)
    return n === null ? 'layout' : { rule: 'bracket', fix: nearestFix(prefix, table, n, sign) }
  }
  if ((m = base.match(WIDTH_RE))) {
    const [, prefix, value] = m
    const widths = DATA.tokens.borderWidth
    if (value in widths) return null
    const inner = value.match(/^\[(.+)\]$/)?.[1]
    const n = inner ? lengthPx(inner) : parseFloat(value)
    if (n === null) return null // a colour or a variable in brackets: rule 4's
    return { rule: inner ? 'bracket' : 'scale', fix: nearestFix(prefix, widths, n, sign) }
  }
  if ((m = base.match(/^text-([6-9]xl)$/))) {
    // Tailwind's own sizes, which Quill's re-cut scale does not share a name with: its
    // text-6xl (60px) is smaller than Quill's text-5xl (88px), so compare by size, not name.
    const n = TAILWIND_TEXT[m[1]]
    const [k, v] = nearestStep(DATA.tokens.text, n)
    return { rule: 'scale', fix: `→ text-${k} (${fmt(v)}), the nearest Quill size; ${base} is Tailwind's own (${fmt(n)})` }
  }
  if ((m = base.match(/^rounded(-[tblrse]{1,2})?$/))) {
    return { rule: 'scale', fix: `→ ${base}-sm (${fmt(DATA.tokens.radius.sm)}): a bare ${base} is Tailwind's own step, the same size` }
  }
  return null
}

// Rule 5 (classes): a retired Quill utility name. Longest name first so `indigo-brand-deep`
// is never reported as `indigo-brand`.
export function retiredRule(base) {
  for (const name of Object.keys(DATA.retired.classes).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)) {
    if (base.includes(name)) {
      const r = DATA.retired.classes[name]
      return { rule: 'retired', fix: `→ ${base.replace(name, r.use)} (renamed in ${r.since}; the old name compiles to nothing since ${r.removed})` }
    }
  }
  return null
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ raw colours + retired vars (whole text)
// A hex inside a bracket utility (bg-[#F5EDDD]) is rule 4's finding, not a second raw-colour one: `[` is in the lookbehind.
const HEX_RE = /(?<![\w&#[-])#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{3,4})(?![\w-])/g
const FN_RE = /\b(?:rgba?|hsla?|oklch|oklab)\([^)]*\)/g
const NOT_COLOUR_ATTR = /(?:href|to|id|htmlFor|key|name|aria-[a-z]+|data-[a-z-]+)=["'{`]?$/

  const s = h.length === 4 || h.length === 5 ? h.slice(1, 4).split('').map((c) => c + c).join('') : h.slice(1, 7)
  return [0, 2, 4].map((i) => parseInt(s.slice(i, i + 2), 16))
}
export function hexHint(value, prefix = 'bg') {
  if (!value.startsWith('#')) return Object.keys(DATA.swatches).slice(0, 4).map((r) => `${prefix}-${r}`).join(', ') + ', …'
  const [r, g, b] = hex2rgb(value)
  const near = Object.entries(DATA.swatches)
    .map(([name, hex]) => { const [x, y, z] = hex2rgb(hex); return [name, (x - r) ** 2 + (y - g) ** 2 + (z - b) ** 2] })
    .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])
    .slice(0, 2)
  return near.map(([name]) => `${prefix}-${name} (${DATA.swatches[name]})`).join(' or ')

export function rawColourFindings(lines) {
  const out = []
  lines.forEach((text, i) => {
    for (const re of [HEX_RE, FN_RE]) {
      for (const m of text.matchAll(re)) {
        if (NOT_COLOUR_ATTR.test(text.slice(Math.max(0, m.index - 12), m.index))) continue
        out.push({ line: i + 1, col: m.index + 1, rule: 'raw-color', value: m[0], fix: `→ a role or pigment — nearest ${hexHint(m[0])}; a brand mark takes \`// quill-check: allow raw-color — <why>\` on the line above` })
      }
    }
    for (const m of text.matchAll(/var\((--[a-z0-9-]+)\)/g)) {
      const r = DATA.retired.vars[m[1]]
      if (r) out.push({ line: i + 1, col: m.index + 1, rule: 'retired', value: m[0], fix: `→ retired in ${r.since} and gone since ${r.removed}, so it resolves to nothing; it was ${r.aliases} — use the role that owns that value (roles section of .claude/rules/quill.md)` })
    }
  })
  return out
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ allows
// `quill-check: allow <rule> — <why>`. On the same line it covers that line; on a line of
// its own it covers the element that follows, up to the line that closes the tag — a JSX
// comment cannot sit between a tag's attributes, and an SVG brand mark's fill often does.
// The reason is mandatory: an allow without one is itself a finding, so exceptions never go quiet.
const ALLOW_RE = /quill-check:\s*allow\s+([a-z-]+)(?:\s*[—–-]+\s*(.*?))?\s*(?:\*\/|-->|\}|$)/
const ALLOW_ONLY_LINE = /^\s*(?:\{\/\*|\/\/|\/\*|<!--)\s*quill-check:/
export function allowsFor(lines, lineNo) {
  const found = []
  const same = lines[lineNo - 1]?.match(ALLOW_RE)
  if (same) found.push({ rule: same[1], reason: (same[2] ?? '').trim(), line: lineNo })
  for (let l = lineNo - 1; l >= 1 && l >= lineNo - 12; l--) {
    const text = lines[l - 1]
    if (ALLOW_ONLY_LINE.test(text)) { const m = text.match(ALLOW_RE); if (m) found.push({ rule: m[1], reason: (m[2] ?? '').trim(), line: l }); break }
    if (/>\s*$/.test(text) && l < lineNo - 1) break // a tag closed between: the allow above belongs to that element
  }
  return found
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rule 7: lengths typed by hand
// A padding, margin, gap, offset, radius, font size or border width written as a number in an
// inline style (`style={{ padding: 13 }}`) or an app stylesheet (`padding: 13px`) is the same miss
// as a bracket class, and gets the same answer: the Quill variable, `var(--space-3)`. Zero is not a
// size choice, and a value already built from var() or calc() is left alone.
const PROP_KINDS = [
  ['space', /^(padding|margin)(-(top|right|bottom|left|inline|block)(-(start|end))?)?$|^(gap|row-gap|column-gap|top|right|bottom|left|inset(-(inline|block)(-(start|end))?)?|text-indent|scroll-(padding|margin)(-(top|right|bottom|left|inline|block)(-(start|end))?)?)$/],

  ['text', /^font-size$/],
  ['width', /^(border(-(top|right|bottom|left|inline|block)(-(start|end))?)?-width|outline-width|outline-offset)$/],
  // a shorthand (`border: 1px solid …`): its length is the width
  ['width', /^(border(-(top|right|bottom|left|inline|block)(-(start|end))?)?|outline)$/],

const KIND_TABLE = { space: () => DATA.tokens.space, w: () => sizeTable('width'), h: () => sizeTable('height'), radius: () => DATA.tokens.radius, text: () => DATA.tokens.text, width: () => DATA.tokens.borderWidth }
// a width or height step is a spacing step (`--space-4`) or a size step (`--size-card`)
const stepVar = (k) => (k in DATA.tokens.space ? `--space-${k.replace('.', '_')}` : `--size-${k}`)
const KIND_VAR = { space: stepVar, w: stepVar, h: stepVar, radius: (k) => `--radius-${k}`, text: (k) => `--text-${k}`, width: (k) => `--border-width-${k}` }

// One declaration → null (nothing typed by hand), or { fix }. A number is px, as React reads it.
export function valueRule(prop, value) {
  const kind = PROP_KINDS.find(([, re]) => re.test(prop))?.[0]
  if (!kind || /\$\{/.test(String(value))) return null
  // split at the top level only, so a length inside var(…) or calc(…) stays with it and is left alone
  const parts = typeof value === 'number' ? [`${value}px`] : String(value).trim().match(/(?:[^\s(]+|\([^)]*\))+/g) ?? []
  const lengths = parts.map((part) => [part, lengthPx(part)]).filter(([, n]) => n !== null && n !== 0)
  if (!lengths.length) return null
  const swaps = lengths.map(([part, n]) => {
    const [k, v] = nearestStep(KIND_TABLE[kind](), Math.abs(n))
    const name = KIND_VAR[kind](k)
    return { part, v, exact: Math.abs(v - Math.abs(n)) < 0.05, ref: n < 0 ? `calc(var(${name}) * -1)` : `var(${name})` }
  })
  return { fix: `→ ${swaps.map((sw) => `${sw.part} → ${sw.ref}${sw.exact ? '' : ` (${fmt(sw.v)}, the nearest step)`}`).join(', ')}` }
}

// Every `style={{ … }}` written in place. A style object built elsewhere (a helper that returns
// one) is not read: the check sees text, not values.
export function inlineStyleFindings(text) {
  const out = []
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/style=\{\{/g)) {
    const bodyStart = m.index + m[0].length
    let depth = 2
    let i = bodyStart
    for (; i < text.length && depth > 0; i++) { if (text[i] === '{') depth++; else if (text[i] === '}') depth-- }
    const body = text.slice(bodyStart, i - 2)
    for (const e of body.matchAll(/([A-Za-z]+)\s*:\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?![\w.])|'[^'\n]*'|"[^"\n]*")/g)) {
      const raw = e[2]
      const r = valueRule(kebab(e[1]), /^['"]/.test(raw) ? raw.slice(1, -1) : Number(raw))
      if (r) out.push({ idx: bodyStart + e.index, rule: 'inline-style', value: `${e[1]}: ${raw}`, fix: r.fix })
    }
  }
  return out
}

const lineIndex = (text) => {
  const starts = [0]
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) if (text[i] === '\n') starts.push(i + 1)
  return (idx) => {
    let lo = 0
    let hi = starts.length - 1
    while (lo < hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1
      if (starts[mid] <= idx) lo = mid
      else hi = mid - 1
    }
    return { line: lo + 1, col: idx - starts[lo] + 1 }
  }
}

// One class token through rules 5, 2, 6 and 4, in that order: a finding, 'layout', or null.
const classRule = (c) => retiredRule(c.base) ?? paletteRule(c.base) ?? sizeRule(c.base, c.token) ?? bracketRule(c.base)

// An allow on a finding's line, or above it, marks it allowed; an allow with no reason is a finding.
function applyAllows(file, findings, allowsAt) {
  const seenAllow = new Set()
  for (const f of [...findings]) {
    for (const a of allowsAt(f)) {
      if (a.rule !== f.rule) continue
      if (a.reason) f.allowed = a.reason
      else if (!seenAllow.has(a.line)) {
        seenAllow.add(a.line)
        findings.push({ file, line: a.line, col: 1, rule: 'allow-without-reason', value: a.rule, fix: `→ write the reason after a dash: \`quill-check: allow ${a.rule} — why this one is right\`` })
      }
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ one file
export function scanFile(file, text) {
  const lines = text.split('\n')
  const findings = []
  let layout = 0
  for (const c of extractCandidates(text)) {
    const hit = classRule(c)
    if (hit === 'layout') layout++
    else if (hit) findings.push({ file, line: c.line, col: c.col, rule: hit.rule, value: c.token, fix: hit.fix })
  }
  const at = lineIndex(text)
  for (const f of inlineStyleFindings(text)) { const { idx, ...rest } = f; findings.push({ file, ...at(idx), ...rest }) }
  for (const f of rawColourFindings(lines)) findings.push({ file, ...f })
  applyAllows(file, findings, (f) => allowsFor(lines, f.line))
  return { findings, layout }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ one stylesheet
// An app's own CSS. The theme file itself is skipped (it is where the raw values live), and so
// is every custom-property definition and @theme block: a stylesheet the CLI merged Quill into
// holds Quill's variables, which are the token definitions, not uses. Classes in `@apply` go
// through the class rules. An allow covers its own line, the declaration right below it, or —
// placed above a selector — that rule's whole block.
const THEME_FILE = /(^|[\\/])quill(-theme)?\.css$/
export function scanCss(file, text) {
  const findings = []
  const applies = []
  let layout = 0
  if (THEME_FILE.test(file) || text.includes('@quill-tokens:start')) return { findings, applies, layout }
  const lines = text.split('\n')
  const at = lineIndex(text)
  const clean = text.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, (c) => c.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '))
  const stack = [] // { prelude, line } for every open block
  let buf = ''
  let bufStart = 0
  const handle = (decl, start) => {
    const lead = decl.length - decl.trimStart().length
    const d = decl.trim()
    if (!d || stack.some((b) => b.prelude.startsWith('@theme'))) return
    const pos = at(start + lead)
    const block = stack.at(-1)?.line ?? null
    if (d.startsWith('@apply ')) {
      for (const t of d.slice(7).matchAll(/\S+/g)) {
        const token = t[0]
        const loc = at(start + lead + 7 + t.index)
        const c = { token, base: baseOf(token), ...loc }
        applies.push(c)
        const hit = classRule(c)
        if (hit === 'layout') layout++
        else if (hit) findings.push({ file, ...loc, rule: hit.rule, value: token, fix: hit.fix, block })
      }
      return
    }
    const m = d.match(/^([a-z-]+)\s*:\s*([\s\S]+)$/)
    if (!m) return
    const r = valueRule(m[1], m[2].replace(/\s*!important$/, ''))
    if (r) findings.push({ file, ...pos, rule: 'css-value', value: `${m[1]}: ${m[2].trim()}`, fix: r.fix, block })
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i++) {
    const ch = clean[i]
    if (ch === '{') { stack.push({ prelude: buf.trim(), line: at(i).line }); buf = ''; bufStart = i + 1 }
    else if (ch === ';' || ch === '}') {
      if (stack.length) handle(buf, bufStart)
      if (ch === '}') stack.pop()
      buf = ''
      bufStart = i + 1
    } else buf += ch
  }
  const allowOn = (lineNo) => {
    const text = lines[lineNo - 1] ?? ''
    const m = text.match(ALLOW_RE)
    return m ? [{ rule: m[1], reason: (m[2] ?? '').trim(), line: lineNo }] : []
  }
  // the nearest non-blank line above, if it is a comment of its own
  const allowAbove = (lineNo) => {
    let l = lineNo - 1
    while (l >= 1 && !lines[l - 1].trim()) l--
    return l >= 1 && /^\s*\/\*/.test(lines[l - 1]) ? allowOn(l) : []
  }
  applyAllows(file, findings, (f) => [...allowOn(f.line), ...allowAbove(f.line), ...(f.block ? [...allowOn(f.block), ...allowAbove(f.block)] : [])])
  for (const f of findings) delete f.block
  return { findings, applies, layout }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rule 1: ask the app's own Tailwind
// A Tailwind v4 utility exists only if the app's entry stylesheet defines its token. Compiling
// every candidate with the app's installed Tailwind is exact and needs no maintained list; a
// class that emits no CSS is dead in THIS app — a typo, or a theme that is not wired in.
const ENTRY_CANDIDATES = ['app/globals.css', 'src/app/globals.css', 'styles/globals.css', 'src/styles/globals.css']
const escapeClass = (s) => s.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, (ch) => '\\' + ch)

// A CSS package (tailwindcss, tw-animate-css, shadcn/tailwind.css) is not a JS module: its
// package.json points at the stylesheet through `exports[…].style`, `style` or a .css main, so
// Node's own resolver throws. Walk node_modules up from the importing file, then from cwd.
const findPackage = (name, from) => {
  let dir = from
  for (;;) {
    const p = join(dir, 'node_modules', name, 'package.json')
    if (existsSync(p)) return dirname(p)
    const up = dirname(dir)
    if (up === dir) return null
    dir = up
  }
}
export function resolveCssImport(id, base, cwd) {
  if (id.startsWith('.') || id.startsWith('/')) return resolve(base, id)
  const m = id.match(/^(@[^/]+\/[^/]+|[^/]+)(\/.*)?$/)
  const dir = findPackage(m[1], base) ?? findPackage(m[1], cwd)
  if (!dir) throw new Error('cannot find package ' + m[1] + ' from ' + base)
  const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
  const sub = m[2] ? '.' + m[2] : '.'
  const pick = (e) => (typeof e === 'string' ? e : e && typeof e === 'object' ? pick(e.style ?? e.default ?? e.import ?? Object.values(e)[0]) : null)
  let rel = pkg.exports ? pick(pkg.exports[sub] ?? (sub === '.' ? pkg.exports : null)) : null
  if (!rel && sub !== '.') rel = sub
  if (!rel) rel = pkg.style ?? (typeof pkg.main === 'string' && pkg.main.endsWith('.css') ? pkg.main : 'index.css')
  return join(dir, rel)
}

export async function resolveWithTailwind({ cwd, css, candidates }) {
  const entry = css
    ? resolve(cwd, css)
    : ENTRY_CANDIDATES.map((p) => join(cwd, p)).find((p) => existsSync(p) && /@import\s+["']tailwindcss["']/.test(readFileSync(p, 'utf8')))
  if (!entry || !existsSync(entry)) return { skipped: 'rule 1 skipped: no Tailwind entry found (a stylesheet with @import "tailwindcss") — run from the app root or pass --css <path>' }
  let tw
  let req
  try {
    req = createRequire(join(cwd, 'package.json'))
    // require.resolve lands on the CommonJS build, whose exports sit under `default`.
    const mod = await import(req.resolve('tailwindcss'))
    tw = typeof mod.compile === 'function' ? mod : mod.default
  } catch {
    return { skipped: 'rule 1 skipped: tailwindcss v4 not found from ' + cwd + ' — run from the app root' }
  }
  if (typeof tw.compile !== 'function') return { skipped: 'rule 1 skipped: tailwindcss v4 (compile API) is required' }
  const loadStylesheet = async (id, base) => {
    const p = resolveCssImport(id, base, cwd)
    return { base: dirname(p), content: readFileSync(p, 'utf8') }
  }
  const compiled = await tw.compile(readFileSync(entry, 'utf8'), { base: dirname(entry), loadStylesheet, loadModule: async () => ({ base: cwd, module: {} }) })
  const out = compiled.build([...candidates, 'dark:bg-background', 'bg-background', ...RADIUS_KEYS.map((k) => `rounded-${k}`)])
  const unresolved = new Set([...candidates].filter((c) => !out.includes('.' + escapeClass(c))))
  const wired = out.includes('.bg-background')
  // what each rounded-* compiles to in THIS app: the value the inspector shows
  const radii = Object.fromEntries(RADIUS_KEYS.map((k) => [k, out.match(new RegExp(`\\.rounded-${k}\\s*\\{\\s*border-radius:\\s*([^;]+);`))?.[1]?.trim() ?? null]))
  // Tailwind keeps the LAST @custom-variant dark. shadcn init writes a stock one (.dark only);
  // if it sits below Quill's, dark: stops following data-theme while everything else works.
  const darkRule = out.match(/\.dark\\:bg-background[^{]*/)?.[0] ?? ''
  const darkFollowsThemes = darkRule.includes('[data-theme=')
  return { unresolved, entry, darkFollowsThemes, wired, radii }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ rule radius-override
// `shadcn init` writes its own radius lines (`--radius-md: calc(var(--radius) * 0.8)`) and
// `--radius: 0.625rem`. The CLI install replaces them; a theme FILE imported above them loses to
// them, because the last definition wins: rounded-xl then renders 14px instead of Quill's 16px,
// silently (measured in a fresh app, 2026-10-16). Read from the compiled CSS, so it is exact.
const RADIUS_KEYS = ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', '2xl', '3xl', '4xl']
const QUILL_IMPORT = /@import\s+(url\()?["']?[^"')]*quill[^"')]*\.css/
const MOVE_IMPORT = 'or make `@import "./quill-theme.css"` the last line of this file, so Quill\'s definitions come last and win'

// A radius value in px: a length, or shadcn's shapes built on --radius. null when it cannot tell.
export function radiusPx(value, base) {
  const v = String(value).trim()
  if (LENGTH.test(v)) return lengthPx(v)
  if (v === 'var(--radius)') return base
  const m = v.match(/^calc\(var\(--radius\)\s*([*+-])\s*([\d.]+)(px|rem)?\)$/)
  if (!m) return null
  const n = m[3] ? lengthPx(m[2] + m[3]) : parseFloat(m[2])
  return m[1] === '*' ? base * n : m[1] === '+' ? base + n : base - n
}

// The app's entry stylesheet + what its rounded-* compile to → findings on the lines that override Quill.
export function radiusFindings(file, text, radii) {
  const lines = text.split('\n')
  const lastLine = (re) => { for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (re.test(lines[i])) return i; return -1 }
  const importAt = lastLine(QUILL_IMPORT)
  const quill = DATA.tokens.radius
  const quillBase = DATA.tokens.radiusBase
  const findings = []
  // --radius itself: shadcn's primitives read it directly. The last declaration in the file wins,
  // unless Quill's theme file is imported after it.
  const baseAt = lastLine(/^\s*--radius\s*:/)
  let base = quillBase
  if (baseAt >= 0 && baseAt > importAt) {
    const v = lines[baseAt].match(/--radius\s*:\s*([^;]+);/)?.[1]?.trim() ?? ''
    const n = lengthPx(v)
    if (n !== null) base = n
    if (n !== null && Math.abs(n - quillBase) > 0.05) {
      findings.push({ file, line: baseAt + 1, col: 1, rule: 'radius-override', value: `--radius: ${v}`, fix: `→ this is shadcn's --radius (${fmt(n)}), not Quill's (${fmt(quillBase)}), and it comes after Quill's theme, so it wins wherever --radius is read: delete the line, ${MOVE_IMPORT}` })
    }
  }
  for (const k of RADIUS_KEYS) {
    const v = radii[k]
    if (!v || v === `var(--radius-${k})`) continue
    const n = radiusPx(v, base)
    const onRadius = /var\(--radius\)/.test(v)
    if (!onRadius && n !== null && Math.abs(n - quill[k]) < 0.05) continue // Quill's own value, written as a length (themes before 1.28.0)
    const at = lastLine(new RegExp(`^\\s*--radius-${k}\\s*:`))
    const renders = n === null ? `rounded-${k} reads ${v}` : `rounded-${k} renders ${fmt(n)}`
    const same = n !== null && Math.abs(n - quill[k]) < 0.05 ? ` (the same as Quill's ${fmt(quill[k])} today, only because --radius is ${fmt(base)})` : `, Quill's is ${fmt(quill[k])}`
    findings.push({ file, line: at + 1 || 1, col: 1, rule: 'radius-override', value: at >= 0 ? lines[at].trim().replace(/;$/, '') : `rounded-${k}: ${v}`, fix: `→ shadcn's radius line overrides Quill's: ${renders}${same}. Delete it (Quill's theme defines every radius), ${MOVE_IMPORT}` })
  }
  return findings
}

const editDistance = (a, b) => {
  const d = Array.from({ length: a.length + 1 }, (_, i) => [i, ...Array(b.length).fill(0)])
  for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) d[0][j] = j
  for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) d[i][j] = Math.min(d[i - 1][j] + 1, d[i][j - 1] + 1, d[i - 1][j - 1] + (a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1))
  return d[a.length][b.length]
}

const NOT_WIRED = "→ Quill's theme is not wired into Tailwind here, so font-heading, the role classes and the status classes are all dead. Add `@import \"./quill-theme.css\"` to the stylesheet that holds `@import \"tailwindcss\"` (not to layout.tsx), or install with the CLI: npx shadcn@latest add @quill/quill"

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ run
export async function runCheck({ cwd = process.cwd(), dirs, includeUi = false, css, tailwind = true } = {}) {
  const files = listFiles(cwd, { dirs: dirs ?? [cwd], includeUi })
  const findings = []
  const notes = []
  let layout = 0
  const candidates = new Map() // token → [{ file, line, col }]
  for (const f of files) {
    const text = readFileSync(f, 'utf8')
    const rel = relative(cwd, f)
    const css = extname(f) === '.css'
    const r = css ? scanCss(rel, text) : scanFile(rel, text)
    findings.push(...r.findings)
    layout += r.layout
    for (const c of css ? r.applies : extractCandidates(text)) (candidates.get(c.token) ?? candidates.set(c.token, []).get(c.token)).push({ file: rel, line: c.line, col: c.col })
  }
  if (tailwind) {
    const flagged = new Set(findings.map((f) => f.value))
    const r = await resolveWithTailwind({ cwd, css, candidates: [...candidates.keys()] })
    if (r.skipped) notes.push(r.skipped)
    else {
      // wired (bg-background resolves) but dark: ignores data-theme: the stock variant line won
      if (!r.unresolved.has('bg-background') && !r.darkFollowsThemes && candidates.has('bg-background')) {
        const entryText = readFileSync(r.entry, 'utf8').split('\n')
        const stock = entryText.findIndex((l) => /@custom-variant\s+dark\b/.test(l) && !l.includes('data-theme'))
        // Two ways to get here: the theme IS imported from this stylesheet but above the stock line,
        // or it is not imported from here at all (a layout.tsx import keeps the colours, which are
        // plain variables, while Tailwind never sees the variant). Say which.
        const imported = entryText.some((l) => QUILL_IMPORT.test(l))
        const fix = imported
          ? "→ this stock line sits below Quill's and wins, so dark: fires only on .dark and never on data-theme: make the @import of quill-theme.css the last line of this file (or delete this line — Quill's variant keeps .dark working)"
          : "→ Quill's theme is not imported from this stylesheet (a layout.tsx import keeps its colours, but Tailwind never sees its dark variant), so dark: fires only on .dark and never on data-theme: add `@import \"./quill-theme.css\"` as the last line of this file"
        findings.push({ file: relative(cwd, r.entry), line: stock + 1 || 1, col: 1, rule: 'dark-variant', value: '@custom-variant dark', fix })
      }
      // Only where Quill's theme is in this stylesheet (imported, or merged in by the CLI): without it
      // the radii are Tailwind's, and the dark-variant or unresolved finding already says why.
      const entryCss = readFileSync(r.entry, 'utf8')
      if (r.wired && (QUILL_IMPORT.test(entryCss) || /^\s*--space-4\s*:/m.test(entryCss))) findings.push(...radiusFindings(relative(cwd, r.entry), entryCss, r.radii))
      const dead = [...r.unresolved].filter((t) => !flagged.has(t))
      // Three or more Quill classes dead at once is not three typos — the theme is missing.
      const notWired = dead.filter((t) => QUILL.has(baseOf(t))).length >= 3
      for (const t of dead) {
        const base = baseOf(t)
        let fix
        if (notWired && QUILL.has(base)) fix = NOT_WIRED
        else {
          const near = DATA.quillClasses.map((q) => [q, editDistance(base, q)]).filter(([, d]) => d <= 2).sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])[0]
          fix = near ? `→ no such utility — looks like a typo of ${near[0]}` : '→ no such utility in this app (it produces no CSS)'
        }
        for (const loc of candidates.get(t)) findings.push({ ...loc, rule: 'unresolved', value: t, fix })
      }
    }
  }
  findings.sort((a, b) => (a.file < b.file ? -1 : a.file > b.file ? 1 : a.line - b.line || a.col - b.col))
  return { findings, layout, notes }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ output
const RULE_LABEL = { 'radius-override': 'radius', unresolved: 'unresolved', palette: 'palette', 'raw-color': 'raw colour', bracket: 'bracket', scale: 'off scale', 'inline-style': 'inline style', 'css-value': 'css value', retired: 'retired', 'dark-variant': 'dark:', 'allow-without-reason': 'allow' }
export const isActive = (f) => !f.allowed

export function formatText({ findings, layout, notes }, { quiet = false } = {}) {
  const lines = []
  const active = findings.filter(isActive)
  if (!quiet) {
    let current = null
    for (const f of findings) {
      if (f.file !== current) {
        current = f.file
        if (lines.length) lines.push('')
        lines.push(f.file)
      }
      lines.push(`  ${String(f.line).padStart(4)}  ${f.value.padEnd(28)}  ${RULE_LABEL[f.rule].padEnd(12)}  ${f.allowed ? `allowed — ${f.allowed}` : f.fix}`)
    }
    if (lines.length) lines.push('')
  }
  const allowed = findings.filter((f) => f.allowed).length
  lines.push(`${active.length} finding${active.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${allowed} allowed · ${layout} layout size${layout === 1 ? '' : 's'} not checked`)
  for (const n of notes) lines.push(n)
  return lines.join('\n')
}

export async function main(argv = process.argv.slice(2)) {
  const opts = { dirs: [], includeUi: false, json: false, quiet: false, css: undefined }
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const a = argv[i]
    if (a === '--dir') opts.dirs.push(resolve(process.cwd(), argv[++i]))
    else if (a === '--css') opts.css = argv[++i]
    else if (a === '--include-ui') opts.includeUi = true
    else if (a === '--json') opts.json = true
    else if (a === '--quiet') opts.quiet = true
    else if (a === '--help' || a === '-h') {
      console.log(`quill-check ${DATA.version}\n  node scripts/quill-check.mjs [--dir <path>]... [--css <tailwind entry>] [--include-ui] [--json] [--quiet]\n  Lists every place the code stepped outside Quill, with the fix to write. Exit 1 when anything is found.`)
      return 0
    } else {
      console.error(`unknown option ${a} — try --help`)
      return 2
    }
  }
  const result = await runCheck({ cwd: process.cwd(), dirs: opts.dirs.length ? opts.dirs : undefined, includeUi: opts.includeUi, css: opts.css })
  const active = result.findings.filter(isActive).length
  const allowed = result.findings.filter((f) => f.allowed).length
  if (opts.json) console.log(JSON.stringify({ version: DATA.version, summary: { findings: active, allowed, layout: result.layout, notes: result.notes }, findings: result.findings }, null, 1))
  else console.log(formatText(result, { quiet: opts.quiet }))
  return active ? 1 : 0
}

// Compared as real file paths: run through a symlink (a macOS temp folder is one), argv[1] and
// import.meta.url name different paths, and a string comparison would skip main() and exit 0 having
// checked nothing.
function isMain() {
  if (!process.argv[1]) return false
  try { return realpathSync(process.argv[1]) === realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) } catch { return false }
}

// exitCode, not exit(): on macOS a pipe is asynchronous, and exit() dropped the tail of a
// --json report past ~64 KB — the agent reading it got "Unterminated string".
if (isMain()) process.exitCode = await main()
